findings.title: Plan document left as the unfilled scaffold
findings.why: The scaffold comment itself says to fill in the body and replace the placeholder comments. The new plan 1-6 has only that comment and no plan content, so it records nothing about the fix. The older plan files (1-2 to 1-5) that I checked in this change's context, including 1-5, were left the same way.

findings.title: Scaffold placeholder comment left in task-006 body
findings.why: The template comment that says to replace the placeholders was kept above the real content. It is boilerplate noise in a finished task document.
